description: This Java source file defines an Android activity named LayoutAnimation4, which displays a grid of app icons loaded from the device's launcher activities, with associated adapter classes and methods.

classes.name: LayoutAnimation4
classes.description: An Android activity that displays a grid of app icons with layout animation.

classes.name: AppsAdapter
classes.description: A custom adapter extending BaseAdapter to provide icon views for the grid.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Activity lifecycle method that initializes the activity, loads apps, and sets up the grid view with the adapter.

methods.name: loadApps
methods.description: Loads a list of launchable applications using the package manager and intent queries.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Provides the view for each grid item, creating and configuring ImageView instances with app icons.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of items to display in the grid, capped at 32.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Returns the ResolveInfo object for the specified position.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns the position as the item ID.
